working: The negative electron gain enthalpies (in kJ/mol) are approximately Cl −349, F −328, Br −325 and I −295. Chlorine is highest because fluorine's very small 2p shell causes strong repulsion between electrons, which reduces its value. Taking magnitude (negative electron gain enthalpy), the order is Cl > F > Br > I. Read as signed numbers, the order would be I > Br > F > Cl, which is not offered, so the magnitude reading is clearly intended.
